subject: "Standard" IRT parameters for Rating Scale model

messages.author: 885539f3f5ae8fd5
messages.subject: "Standard" IRT parameters for Rating Scale model
parts:
Hi,

Thanks for writing such a great package for IRT model fitting! One problem I've come across, though, is that when calling coef(obj,IRTpars=TRUE) where obj is a mirt object fitted with the Rating Scale model, I get the same parameters in the output as when leaving IRTpars=FALSE. Does the package not support converting the mirt parameterization into the standard IRT parameterization for the Rating Scale model?

Thanks,
Jon

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: "Standard" IRT parameters for Rating Scale model
parts:
Hi Jon,

As it stands, no the package does not convert Rating scale models
(i.e., itemtype = 'rating' || 'grsm'), mainly because I haven't gone
through the math for the conversion yet. It's on my todo list, and
will post here after I've added this feature. Cheers.

Phil
